title: Portuguese conquest of Angónia
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Portuguese conquest of Angónia", at revision 1382894131, opens: "The Conquest of Angónia was one of the Portuguese campaigns of occupation and pacification that took place in late 1899, which contributed to the formation of the current territory of Mozambique." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q135397833, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1899 conquest". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
